reasons: All five of A's slogans twist a genuinely Russian idiom (крошить батон, мять булки, хлебом не корми, свой в доску/разделочная доска), and each twist works. B's best lines (Сдоба пожаловать, Жуй пока горячо, Батоны крошим только уткам) are strong and shorter, but its fifth slogan is an awkward ellipsis with a weak pun. A's explanation slightly misnumbers which slogans rework proverbs.

A: Explanation says the second and fourth slogans are inverted proverbs, though the proverb-based ones are the third and fourth (the second is an idiom).
